verdict.rationale: Ironclad documents its own Data Exports capability, triggered through the Public API, and a Records API for retrieving records and reading contract documents, so programmatic export exists. The evidence does not say the export covers all data or what formats it uses, and API access requires a separate add-on. Missing for 10: confirmation that the export covers all account data, documented open export formats (e.g. CSV/JSON/PDF), a no-API or self-serve bulk export path, independent or hands-on corroboration of a complete exit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave

citations.quote: Client submits an API request via Public API with request body payload to trigger an export job
The corresponding Records API allows you to retrieve, update, and create records.
integrations can interface directly with underlying contract documents, reading contract text or updating new versions of the document
you may want to use the API to persist signed agreements to an internal system, or customize where it is stored
